visual_format: annotated scene (drawn cutaway with numbered callouts)
visual_text: From armchair to toilet: seven things to check
Illustrative drawing. These are things to check, not treatments shown to work in trials.
1. A chair or bed at a height the person can stand up from
5. A toilet that can be seen
6. Clothes that are easy to undo
At night: a light, and a commode or urinal bottle by the bed
Frank, Can Fam Physician, 2010; Brown, J Am Geriatr Soc, 2000; Pesonen, J Urol, 2020
alt_text: Cutaway drawing of a home. An older man with white hair rises from a green armchair beside a bed, with a four-wheeled walker in reach. A night light lights the hall, a bay door opens to a bathroom with a raised toilet seat and grab rails. Seven numbered markers match seven things to check; a commode and urinal bottle by the bed are marked for night.
